scope: Ensure the GTK2 preview regenerates when source inputs change and accepts scenes without scrollbars only when their receipts match current sources.

findings.before: The GTK2 preview cache checked the project and palette but did not compare receipt source hashes with the current generator sources.
findings.change: Add generation_sources_current(); the GTK2 cache is invalidated when a listed source is missing, unsafe, outside the project root, or has a different SHA-256. The receipt lists backend.py and scene_contract.py alongside the GTK2 generators because they supply translation helpers and scene masks.

findings.before: Snapshot validation required a scrollbar style identity and RC bindings even when the selected scene contained no scrollbar.
findings.change: Validate scrollbar identity and bindings only when the scene contains scroll_h or scroll_v; always reject receipts whose source hashes are stale.

verification.method: Static source-path and cache-flow review plus focused, non-GUI GTK2 route and generation checks; scoped git diff --check.

focused_checks.result: passed; 5 tests, including stale scene_contract.py source receipt invalidation
passed; frame-only scene generated and validated without scrollbar style identity; receipt records backend.py and scene_contract.py

limits: The installed GTK2 theme for lsi is unchanged; the existing deployed theme remains selected.
No GTK2 native preview or user-visible repaint was observed after these source changes.
I517 remains the separate authorization gate for pressed/released historical input in the VM.
next: Validate the GTK2 native preview in an authorized isolated display; the non-GUI checks now cover source invalidation and a frame-only scene, but do not prove live painting or fidelity.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: GTK2 deployment and normal scrollbar comparisons remain recorded; preview cache integration, held-state historical comparison, and manual visual acceptance remain open. This is not a fidelity score.
